name: quick-peek
description: The paths in Claude's replies become links: hover one to preview it in a window by the pointer (macOS and Windows), click it to show it in Finder or Explorer.

window.title: Preview in a window
window.description: Show the preview in a small window by the pointer: on macOS the file's Quick Look thumbnail, on Windows Explorer's thumbnail or icon, or a file's lines of code; with its kind, size and age. Off, the terminal shows a one-line card over the path.
